items.label: Gene therapy (AAV2-ND4 / NFS-02) x Leber hereditary optic neuropathy
items.rationale: Significant BCVA gains (42131170) with phase 2 signals (42627399); responder rates flat (42131170); weak idebenone standard (42608929); mild AEs only (42627399, NCT05820152).

items.label: Elamipretide x primary mitochondrial diseases
items.rationale: Approved on muscle strength (42794697); sustained single-patient improvement (40816230); cardiac modification unconfirmed (42794697); phase 3/4 pending (NCT05162768, NCT07531251); no phase 3 negative, no cap.

items.label: Idebenone x Leber hereditary optic neuropathy
items.rationale: Conflicting metas: effectiveness unclear (42608929) vs significant partial visual recovery with early treatment (42535808); oral, safe, approved (42608929).

items.label: MitoQ x primary mitochondrial diseases
items.rationale: Review-level only, efficacy unclear (42229401, 42032617); landscape: 110 interventional trials, several late-stage negative/inconclusive (42361626); no disease-modifying PMD standard (42794697).

items.label: Elamipretide x chronic heart failure
items.rationale: Thin evidence base (1 ref). Significant preclinical muscle-force/anti-atrophy effects (42290373); no HF trial registered; GDMT standard exists (42290373).

items.label: Mitochondrial-augmentation cell therapy (MSC transfer / MNV-201) x primary mitochondrial diseases
items.rationale: Preclinical meta positive but non-significant (42453608); single-arm phase 2 registry, no results (NCT06017869); no PMD standard (42361626); IV delivery/safety unresolved (42453608).

items.label: MitoQ x Alzheimer's disease/dementia
items.rationale: Thin evidence base (1 ref, total capped at 4). Single scoping review: positive non-significant preclinical signals (41596136); no active trials; oral, safe (41596136).

items.label: Inflammaging-targeted therapies x age-related multimorbidity
items.rationale: Thin evidence base (1 ref, total capped at 4). Class-level meta: reduced SASP factors and CVD benefits, non-significant (42781074); phase 2 ongoing (42781074); no disease-modifying standard (42781074).

outsiders: MitoQ x Alzheimer's/dementia (4.0): single scoping review (41596136), no clinical-trial data, thin-evidence cap applied
Inflammaging-targeted therapies x age-related multimorbidity (4.0): single class-level meta (42781074), all outcomes non-significant, thin-evidence cap applied
caveats: No posted results for elamipretide phase 3 (NCT05162768) or phase 4 (NCT07531251); approval rests on a muscle-strength surrogate and cardiac modification is unconfirmed (42794697), so effect_direction may be optimistic
Corpus lacks standard-of-care comparator arms for PMD and HF; comparisons are mito-arm-only, a genuine gap (42361626)
Registry-only trials (NCT05820152, NCT06017869) raised pipeline_momentum only, never evidence_quality or effect_direction, per rubric
Thin-evidence cap (fewer than 2 ref_ids, total <= 4) applied to elamipretide x HF, MitoQ x AD, and inflammaging x multimorbidity
